title: 月圓鬼市贖魂
style_en: Late Qing Jiangnan mountain ghost market, full moon night, misty lanterns, memory currency, eerie melancholic atmosphere

world.place: 江南山城外，只在月圓夜出現的鬼市
world.extra: 鬼市用記憶當錢，賣掉的記憶再也回不來
world.goal: 在天亮前從鬼市贖回妹妹失去的魂魄

protagonist.name: 小滿
protagonist.profile: 山城藥舖的學徒，妹妹昨夜突然失了魂

characters.name: 青蘿
characters.appearance: 外表 18 歲的狐仙少女，及腰墨綠色長髮，金色豎瞳，頭上一對白色狐耳，淺綠色交領襦裙，腰間繫紅繩鈴鐺
characters.personality: 狡黠愛捉弄人，其實心軟
characters.relationship: 鬼市的引路人，對主角的藥香很好奇
characters.appearance_en: 18-year-old fox spirit girl, waist-length dark green hair, golden vertical pupils, white fox ears, light green cross-collar ruqun, red string bell at waist

characters.name: 老墨
characters.appearance: 看不出年紀的瘦高男子，灰白長髮用木簪束起，戴半張黑色面具，深紫色長袍，手持算盤
characters.speech: 惜字如金，開口就是價錢
characters.relationship: 鬼市掌櫃，收著妹妹的魂
characters.appearance_en: ageless tall thin man, gray-white long hair tied with wooden hairpin, half black mask, deep purple robe, abacus

ghost_market_entrance.name: 鬼市入口
ghost_market_entrance.image_prompt: Ancient stone archway entrance to Jiangnan ghost market, full moonlight piercing thin mist, rows of dim paper lanterns glowing blue-green, wet bluestone pavement reflecting light, shadowy stalls fading into fog, midnight

ghost_market_interior.name: 鬼市深處
ghost_market_interior.image_prompt: narrow foggy alley in a supernatural night market, green phosphorescent glow on ancient stone slabs, stalls selling bizarre glowing items, blue lanterns hanging low, mist swirling, eerie but atmospheric, no people

mountain_drugstore.name: 山城藥舖
mountain_drugstore.image_prompt: A traditional Chinese medicine shop in a misty mountain town at pre-dawn, wooden shelves filled with herb jars, mortar and pestle on counter, dim oil lamp light, cold blue-gray atmosphere
